facts_must_obey: Gemini 4 Carbon 已在 2026-10-29 收录（xnew-20261030-am.json）。本窗 @Google 的演示帖是已报模型的使用案例，不得再收，也不得做本档建站热词。

Gemini Robotics 2.5 已在 2026-11-11 上午收录（官方首发原为 @GoogleDeepMind 2026-11-10 23:00）。本窗 @Google 2026-11-12 00:08 的介绍是同一产品的转发/再介绍，不得再收。
OpenAI Decisions API 已在 2026-10-23 收录，与本窗 Google 的 Gemini Decisions API / Gemini Decision 1 不是同一产品，不得混名。
「Gemini 在 Google 地图 CarPlay 导航」已在 2026-10-22 收录，指的是 Google 地图里的 Gemini 导航能力。本窗 @Google 宣布的是 Gemini 应用本身直接登上 Apple CarPlay（Gemini Live 免提对话），不是同一功能，可按功能更新收录，kind 必须是 not_model，desc 末尾写「不是新模型」，并写清区别。

Gemini Decision 1 与 Gemini Decisions API 是 @Google 本窗首发：在 Google AI Studio 推出 Gemini Decisions API，由新模型 Gemini Decision 1 驱动。该模型不是按 token 生成长文本，而是把输入（文本、图像、音频、视频、PDF）对照最多 1,000 个问题一次评估并给出决策；输出 token 不计费。官方线程补充：适合工作流/代理只需快速判断的场景，返回校准后的置信度分数，端到端 150–250 毫秒，定价 $0.10 / 100 万 input tokens，官方称在共享基准上比 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite + Interactions API 成本效率约高 5 倍。使用方式是提供是/否、选择题和评分清单，而不是让模型描述图片；官方演示为 4.5 秒扫描 100 张配送照片（官方称比 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 快约 4 倍），每张同时回答 16 个问题。官方帖 https://x.com/Google/status/2120583966272983331 （2026-11-12 02:26，views=273174，bookmarks=628）。官方博客 https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/gemini-decisions-api/ 。kind=model（可在同一条或拆条说明 API 是产品接口）。不得把用途写成通用聊天模型。

Tabletop 是 @Google 本窗宣布的 @GoogleLabs 协作空间/实验：可创建自定义工具，邀请朋友、家人或社团进入共享中心同时编辑；官方举例包括旅行行程、聚餐（含现场投票）、费用分摊、幻想体育对阵表（fantasy league / sports brackets）。官方卡片与博客写明这是 Google Labs experiment，需加入 waitlist。官方帖 https://x.com/Google/status/2120561628882125069 （2026-11-12 00:57，views=116914，bookmarks=268）。官方博客 https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/google-labs/tabletop/ 。kind=product 或 not_model，desc 必须写清 Labs 实验/waitlist，并在末尾写「不是新模型」。

AlphaGenome 2 是 @GoogleDeepMind 本窗宣布的新 AI 模型：针对特定细胞解读同一段 DNA，帮助科学家理解为何单字母突变会在部分细胞引发疾病、在其他细胞则不会。官方线程：在 68 种组织、1 亿+ profiles 上训练，一次聚焦一种细胞类型，官方称发现开关基因的突变数量约为前代模型的近两倍；无需重新训练即可适配新实验，只需接入几十个细胞的数据，例如免疫细胞对疫苗的反应、肠道中驱动炎症的细胞、干细胞成熟为血细胞。现已通过 API 和互动 Colab 教程向非商业研究开放。官方首发帖 https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2120532824465805749 （2026-11-11 23:03，views=370737，bookmarks=997）。官方博客 https://deepmind.google/blog/alphagenome-2-deciphering-how-cells-read-dna-to-better-understand-disease/ 。kind=model。不得写成 AlphaProof Code（那是已报的另一产品）。

Gemini 应用登陆 Apple CarPlay：@Google 本窗宣布 Gemini app 可直接在 Apple CarPlay 使用，iOS 用户可在车机屏幕上与 Gemini Live 免提对话，用于查看行程、处理收件箱或口头头脑风暴。官方帖 https://x.com/Google/status/2120596045960790486 （2026-11-12 03:14，views=270276，bookmarks=131）。kind=not_model，desc 末尾写「不是新模型」。

AlphaGenome 2.text:
Your heart, brain, and immune system share the same DNA sequence. So how can a single-letter change affect disease in some cells, while sparing the rest?

AlphaGenome 2 is our new AI model that zooms in on specific cells to help scientists understand what drives disease. 🧵

The model also adapts to lab experiments on the fly with no retraining needed.

Researchers can plug in data from just a few dozen cells to see how DNA changes behave in specific moments, like:
🔘 Immune cells responding to a vaccine
🔘 Specific cells in the gut driving inflammatory disease
🔘 Stem cells maturing into blood cells

Looking at a whole tissue at once is like looking at a blurry image: you get the visuals, but miss what’s happening inside individual pixels.

Trained on 100M+ profiles across 68 tissues, AlphaGenome 2 focuses on one cell type at a time, spotting nearly twice as many mutations that turn genes on and off as our previous model.

By predicting how the same DNA is read differently from cell to cell, AlphaGenome 2 opens up entirely new possibilities for understanding human genetics.

It’s available now for non-commercial research via our API and interactive Colab tutorials. Find out more → https://t.co/cPOPD3cWYB

official_thread_full_texts.text:
Most models are built to generate text, creative content, or reason step-by-step. But not every task needs a written answer.

When a workflow or agent just needs to make a quick call, the Decisions API returns calibrated confidence scores (150–250 ms end-to-end) at $0.10 per 1M input tokens, making it nearly 5x more cost-efficient across the shared benchmark suite than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite with the Interactions API.

official_thread_full_texts.text:
So how do your questions turn into a decision?

Instead of asking a model to describe a photo, you give it a checklist of yes/no, multiple-choice, and rating questions so it knows what to check and what action to take.

Here, Gemini Decision 1 scans 100 delivery photos in 4.5 seconds (nearly 4x faster than Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite), answering 16 questions per photo at once:

📦 Is the box damaged? (yes/no)
🌧️ Is it under a porch? (yes/no)
⭐ What's the delivery quality? (0 to 3 rating)
⚡ What happens next? (routes to a claim review)
